headline: Clayface and Supergirl: creative vision hurdles
post:
Hey everyone! Clayface is currently in theaters and performing well on Rotten Tomatoes and at the box office. But according to ComicBook.com, both this new film and Supergirl are facing criticism for "a lack of cohesive vision and direction". 🎬

Critics point out that Warner Bros. has a history of clashing with directors. This has led to concerns that DC Studios and its filmmakers are not fully aligned. Interestingly, this feels a lot like early Marvel Studios history when veteran directors struggled to find their footing before shifting to up-and-coming talent.

James Gunn now faces the challenge of bringing creative alignment back to the big screen as future projects develop. Did you mind the lack of bigger DCU connections? 🦇

#Clayface #Supergirl #DCStudios
original_title: The DCU Has A Major Problem With Its Movies (And No, It’s Not James Gunn)
